entry.title: Council on Aging: the meeting of 8 September 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Council on Aging agreed to pursue a capital-plan funding request for the senior center's parking lot redesign. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z6Wp_dJsdtA), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
